title: What online work really is
summary: A realistic picture of working online: what it is, what it is not, and how to start without being scammed.

slides.say: Welcome to Work Online the Smart Way, a free course from Jerry Development. In this first lesson we will look at what working online really is, and what it is not.

slides.h:
Online work is real work.
Not a shortcut.
slides.say: Online work is real work. You trade a skill or your time for money, just like in any job. Anyone who promises easy money with no skills and no effort is selling a dream, or a scam.
There are three common ways. Freelancing, where you sell a service to clients. Remote employment, where one company hires you. And selling your own products, content or courses.
People pay for skills. Writing and translation. Design and video editing. Customer support. Programming and data work. And teaching or tutoring. Choose one and get good at it.

pts: Patience: the first month is slow
slides.say: To start you need one clear skill, a phone or a computer with internet, a simple profile with examples of your work, and patience. The first weeks are usually slow, and that is normal.

pts: Never pay to get a job
slides.say: Be realistic. Income takes time to build. Quality matters more than speed. And never pay money to get a job. Real employers pay you, they do not charge you.

slides.h:
Choose one skill.
Build it for 30 days.
slides.say: Your homework: choose one skill and practise it for thirty days. In the next lesson we will see which skills fit you and how to choose one.
